description_en: Deletes an Intelligent Outbound Calling job by instance ID and job ID. After deletion, the job will no longer appear in the outbound calling job list
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID删除智能外呼任务。删除后，获取外呼任务列表时无法获取到该任务
name: DeleteAiOutboundTask

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.

You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The job ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and check the Data field in the response, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and check the TaskId field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

true: Succeeded.

true：成功。
